pkbillmsTransaction.note: This form is designed to select and search for transactions. Transactions differ from payments in that they match all outgoing requests to the service provider. Payments are transactions that are generated by the clients of the system. Several transactions can correspond to one payment (in the case of a single transaction), as well as not a single transaction (if the system has confirmed the possibility of accepting a payment, but an attempt to make a payment has not been formed).
